hook: *3.15 acres* of Moosapet truck-yard land go under the hammer today
hook_b: *3.15 acres* of Moosapet truck-yard land go under the hammer today
tldr: The Telangana High Court reserved orders on two PILs against HMDA's e-auction of 3.15 acres at the Kukatpally truck yard in Moosapet; HMDA says the auction goes ahead Friday.

beats.what: A bench of Acting Chief Justice P Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao reserved orders on Thursday; HMDA says no stay was granted.
beats.why: Petitioners argue land acquired for a public purpose cannot be sold; the state says the terminal plan was cancelled as the area became residential.
beats.care: How the court rules sets the tone for selling other old public-purpose land in the city.

effects.label: PILs say public-purpose land can't be sold
HC orders due on the PILs

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The state told the court truckers now park at Mangalapalli, Ibrahimpatnam and Abdullapurmet outside the ORR.

cards.q: If land acquired for a public project is never used, what should happen to it?

qs: What will the auction proceeds be spent on?
What happens to the rest of the 33.22 acres?

facts.t: Truckers now use *3* parking areas outside the ORR, the state told the court.
The land was acquired in *1981* to keep heavy vehicles out of the city at peak hours.

viz.l: Share of the 1981 acquisition being auctioned
viz.verdict: A small slice of the old truck-terminal land; petitioners and the state disagree on whether it can be sold.

learn.t: PIL = public interest litigation, a case filed in court on behalf of the public

watch: The High Court's order on the two PILs, due Friday, and whether the e-auction result stands.
